issue: ब्रह्माणी रुद्राणी कमला तू ही है जग दाता — the base (Aarti Mala) prints जग दाता; Drik Panchang has जगमाता, which fits the address to the goddesses better. दाता is a valid word (the āratī calls her सुख सम्पत्ति दाता in the next stanza), so the base stays.
our reading: Brahmāṇī, Rudrāṇī, Kamalā: you alone are the giver (to) the world.
alternatives: जगमाता: you alone are the mother of the world (Drik Panchang)

issue: रतन चतुर्दश तोकूं कोई नहीं पाता — read as 'of the fourteen jewels, none attains to you'; the Lakṣmī āratī has रत्न चतुर्दश तुम बिन कोई नहीं पाता ('without you no one obtains the fourteen jewels'). जगनिधि (pad3) is read as 'the ocean of the world' (cf. भवनिधि).
our reading: Of the fourteen jewels, none attains to you.
alternatives: No one obtains the fourteen jewels (without) you
